The weather affects the color of your hibiscus flowers. In hot, sunny weather, the flowers will be brighter oranges and reds. When the weather cools down, the colors will become softer oranges and yellows.

watering:
Water your hibiscus plant regularly and thoroughly. If it's in a pot, water it until water comes out of the bottom hole.

Fertilizing: 
Use a water-soluble fertilizer in combination with a slow-release type. You can also use a complete fertilizer every two to three weeks from April to September. 
Repotting:
Repot your hibiscus every couple of years in early spring. Use a pot that is wide but relatively shallow, and avoid deep pots.

tips:
